svg.text: rx_bias: constant-gm reference for the receiver
MN1 2/0.5, MN2 2/0.5 ×4 (K = 4), Rb 2/29.714 um ppolyf_u (5.2 kOhm): gm of the unit = 1 / Rb (x const), unit current ~25 uA
every tail mirrors nb, so each stage gain gm x RL is a resistor ratio; en = 0: header off, nb and x held low; source: sim/rx/rx_bias.py block()
